subject: Intro + quick qualification before demo — calendar options
messages:
From: Leo Park <leo@marketwise.ai>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Self-serve signup — interested in demo and ramp plan

Hi Sean (and Redwood team),

We just spun up a self-serve account and ran a few tests — MarketWise AI here. We're evaluating options to serve two main features in production:
- semantic search over customer docs (embeddings + rerank)
- a short-form generative assistant for refund/triage (mostly <= 120 tokens output)

High-level traffic snapshot (attached: marketwise_usage_snapshot.csv):
- Day 0 pilot: ~250k queries/day
- Month 3 target: ~2M queries/day (mostly reads/search)
- Typical request: 1–3 short prompts, ~40 tokens input average; generation outputs avg ~80 tokens when used
- Burst concurrency: expect occasional spikes up to ~600 concurrent requests

Other asks:
- Timeline: pilot in ~6 weeks, prod in ~3 months after pilot
- Compliance: SOC 2 required, SSO preferred, some customers need data residency assurances
- Cost sensitivity: want a clear cost/latency tradeoff for quantized vs standard model runs

Would love a short demo (30 min) to see Redwood's hosting options and to walk through suggested ramp patterns. Prefer mornings PT next week (Tue/Wed/Thu between 8:30–11:30 PT).

Attached: marketwise_usage_snapshot.csv (CSV)

Thanks,
Leo Park
Product, MarketWise AI
leo@marketwise.ai

---

Hi Leo — thanks for the note and the upload, this is helpful. I’m Sean (AE on your account) — looping in Monica (Customer Solutions) to help scope throughput and SSO/enterprise requirements. A few quick clarifying questions so we make the demo concrete:

1) For the semantic search path: are you planning to compute embeddings client-side and call Redwood for retrieval/rerank, or host embedding generation with us?
2) Regarding bursts: is the 600 concurrency estimate sustained for minutes or seconds (i.e., short spikes vs steady traffic)?
3) Typical sequence lengths for the refund assistant — do you have a token distribution sample (50/75/100/200 buckets)?
4) Any hard latency SLOs for the assistant (p95 target)? You mentioned <300ms — is that strict for all requests or only for a subset of customers?

Proposed next steps:
- 30-minute technical demo + ramp plan with Monica to cover autoscaling/quantization and pilot milestones.
- If that works, Monica will prepare a short benchmark matrix (TP50/TP95, cost/token estimates) tailored to the CSV you uploaded.

Here are three windows I can offer next week (all PT):
- Tue 2027-06-01 09:00–09:30
- Wed 2027-06-02 10:00–10:30
- Thu 2027-06-03 08:30–09:00

Or send a calendar link and we’ll lock one. I attached a brief demo deck and our pilot checklist for reference.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (PDF), pilot-checklist.md (text)
Related record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Best,
Sean Gallagher

Hi Sean / Monica,

Thanks for the fast reply. We can do the 30-min demo — can you do Mon 2027-05-31 at 13:00 PT instead? Our product and infra leads are only available then.

Answers to your clarifying Qs:
- Embeddings: we plan to generate embeddings in our pipeline for now but are open to moving that to Redwood if the latency/cost profile is better.
- Bursts: 600 is a short spike (a few minutes) tied to batch job completions; steady concurrency will be ~120–180.
- Token distribution (rough): ~55% <= 50 tokens, ~30% 50–100, ~15% >100. We'll export a small sample set for you before the demo.
- Latency: p95 target for the assistant is 350ms for paid customers; non-critical internal flows can be 500–700ms.

Security: SOC 2 is a must for the pilot customers; SSO via SAML preferred. We can share SOC evidence after NDA if helpful.

If Mon 2027-05-31 13:00 PT works, send an invite and agenda and we’ll confirm.

Cheers,
Anika Rao
Head of Product, MarketWise AI
anika@marketwise.ai
